section.p: This module manages campus staff and lecturer profiles—including Lecturers, Admissions (PMB) Staff, Academic Staff (TU), and Deans—and controls which Faculty or Study Program data each staff member is allowed to manage.

div.p: The employee form automatically shows the right fields based on the selected job role—such as NIDN for Lecturers, or work-area limits for PMB and Academic Staff.
Employees registered as Lecturers can be assigned as Academic Advisors (PA), Course Lecturers, or Thesis Supervisors.
Each PMB or Academic Staff member only sees applicants, students, KRS, and KHS belonging to their assigned Faculty or Study Program.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-secondary position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: HR Manager / System Admin
Before adding employees, open Employees → Configuration → Job Positions and set the Academic Role for each position (such as Lecturer, PMB Staff, Academic Staff, or Dean).

ul.li: If a Job Position does not have an Academic Role selected, the system will not show the Lecturer or Jurisdiction tabs on the employee profile, and the person will not appear in Lecturer/Advisor dropdowns.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-info position-relative
div.p: Create the employee record, fill in personal details, choose their Department/Faculty, link their Related User account, and select their Job Position.
div.div: What happens next: Choosing a Lecturer job reveals the academic profile fields (such as NIDN and Home Study Program). Choosing PMB Staff or Academic Staff reveals the Jurisdiction tab.

ul.li: Active User Link Required: To let a lecturer or staff member log in and approve KRS, input KHS grades, or review Theses, they must have a linked Related User on their employee profile.
Same Program for Advisors: A lecturer can only be assigned as a student's Academic Advisor (PA) if they are active and belong to the same Study Program.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-warning position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: HR Manager / Campus Operations Manager
Open the PMB / Academic Jurisdiction tab on the employee profile and select which Faculties or Study Programs that staff member is responsible for.

ul.li: Strict Area Limit: Staff can only view and process applicants, students, KRS, or KHS inside their assigned Faculty/Program.
If a staff member sees an empty list: Check their employee profile and make sure at least one Faculty or Study Program is listed under their Jurisdiction tab.
